meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
Finding the right face wash for oily skin in India's humid climate can make a big difference in controlling excess oil and preventing breakouts.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Lightweight%20Texture%3A%20Unlike%20heavy%20cream,Key%20Ingredients%20to%20Look%20For) Here are some of the top-rated, budget-friendly options available for under ₹500:

---

### Top Face Washes for Oily Skin (Under ₹500)

| Brand & Product | Key Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Why It Works for Oily Skin |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid (BHA), LHA, Zinc | ₹269 – ₹299 | Deep cleans pores, controls sebum production, and helps manage acne and blackheads. |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea, Glycolic Acid | ₹175 – ₹320 | Gently exfoliates dead skin cells, clears out pore buildup, and has antioxidant properties to soothe acne-prone skin. |
| **Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash** | Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid | ₹175 | Provides deep foam cleansing, targets excess oil, and uses the antibacterial properties of tea tree to fight breakouts. |
| **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide | ₹260 – ₹299 | Combines BHA to clear pores with niacinamide to help regulate oil secretion and soothe redness. |
| **The Derma Co. Pore Minimizing Clay Daily Face Wash** | Clay, PHA | ₹209 – ₹249 | Effectively absorbs excess surface oil and impurities without leaving the skin feeling excessively stripped or tight. |

---

### What to Look for When Buying:

* **Key Ingredients:** Look for **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** to clear out pores, **Niacinamide** to regulate oil production, or **Tea Tree/Green Tea** for antibacterial and soothing benefits.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Before%20you%20buy%20oily%20skin,oil%20production%20and%20soothes%20inflammation.)
* **Texture:** **Gel-based** or **foaming** cleansers work best for oily skin types because they remove grime and grease effectively without heavy moisturizers that can feel greasy.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Lightweight%20Texture%3A%20Unlike%20heavy%20cream,Key%20Ingredients%20to%20Look%20For)
* **Gentle Formulations:** Avoid harsh soaps that leave your face feeling "squeaky clean" or tight, as this can trigger your skin to produce even more oil to compensate.

Would you like help choosing between options that target acne specifically versus general oil control?
